issues.description: The Person model's firstName field has different visibility in template and solution. In the template Person.java the firstName field is declared private with public getter/setter, while in the solution Person.java the firstName field is declared public. This discrepancy is structural (field visibility) and can confuse students about the intended encapsulation of the Person model and whether they should access fields directly or via getters/setters.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility of the firstName field consistent across template and solution. Prefer keeping it private and using the existing public getter/setter (revert public firstName in the solution to private), or update the template to match the public field if intentional. Document the intended encapsulation in the model description so students are not confused whether to use direct field access or getters/setters.
